# Interloc Solutions Launches interloc.ai, AI Agents Built for IBM Maximo Asset Management

August 14, 2026 3 min read Qualified Weak I

Tech Jacks Solutions AI News Coverage

Interloc Solutions has launched interloc.ai, an agentic AI platform designed specifically for IBM Maximo and the Maximo Application Suite, according to Ibm. The platform targets industrial and facilities organizations that run asset management operations on Maximo, a narrower scope than general-purpose agents, by design, according to Ibm.

Availability IBM Maximo / Maximo Application Suite enterprise deployments

IBM Maximo is enterprise asset management software used by large industrial, utilities, and facilities organizations to track equipment, schedule maintenance, and manage work orders. It’s not a consumer product, it’s the system a refinery or a hospital network uses to know when a pump needs servicing. Interloc Solutions, a company that builds Maximo-focused software, now says it’s added an agentic AI layer on top: [interloc.ai](https://www.interlocsolutions.com/company/news/interloc-solutions-launches-interloc.

...

That’s vertical-first agent design, and it’s increasingly the approach that gets traction in enterprise asset management, where a generic agent that doesn’t understand the difference between a corrective work order and a preventive maintenance schedule isn’t useful.

The catch is that everything above comes from Interloc itself. The PRNewswire release is down, and no independent editorial coverage of this launch was available at publication. What’s confirmed: the company exists, the product launched, and Interloc’s own website and a [Yahoo Finance aggregation of the press release](https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/ai/articles/interloc-solutions-launches-interloc-ai-130000006.html) carry consistent descriptions of the platform. What isn’t confirmed: whether the agent architecture performs as described, what the actual integration complexity looks like, or how the human-in-the-loop controls behave at scale.
